value: Stealth exploration game where you explore a forest while avoiding the gaze of giant girls. Getting caught leads to a vore game over scene.

On the isolated Lacan island, humans have undergone a dramatic evolution. Females have become over 5 meters tall, while males have become merely 15 centimeters tall. Now, the females only use the males for food or breeding, which has sent the male population into hiding. While escaping a tiny settlement which had been discovered by the giantesses 2 years ago, you encountered a friendly giantess, who remains on your mind to this day.
